title: Meetings, agendas and legislation
publisher: City of New Haven — Board of Alders, through Legistar
description: Find meeting dates, committee information, agendas and legislative records.
steps: Open the meeting calendar and select a year or committee.
Open a meeting's details and available agenda links.
Use the Legislation tab for legislative records and preserve exact record URLs.
contact: Board of Alders / Legislative Services; data/API contact unconfirmed.
limitations: Calendar opened and displayed meeting fields; agenda files and historical completeness were not checked.
Document availability varies by meeting; absence of minutes does not establish that a meeting did not occur.
API access, bulk exports, reuse terms and voting-data coverage remain unconfirmed.
